senses.gloss: m. (preced.) aristocratic, proud, vainglorious, pompous. Pesik. Par., p. 40ᵃ אית לך למימר … שהיה ש׳ will you say of that righteous man (Simeon the high priest) that he was vainglorious?; Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ bot. שִׁיחֵץ היה.—Pl. שְׁחָצִים. Pesik. l. c. וכולם ש׳ היו and all of them (those high priests that made such a display) were ostentatious people, v. שַׁחֲצִית.
